items.title: Aiarty Video Enhancer: local AI upscaling that restores low-res footage to 4K
items.excerpt: An AI-powered video restoration tool that upscales low-resolution footage to 4K while reducing noise and reconstructing detail, with all processing running locally on the user's machine rather than in the cloud.
items.why: A concrete AI post/finishing-toolchain option for filmmakers and archivists: local (no-cloud) AI upscaling/restoration that recovers texture lost to compression or old codecs. Distinct vendor/product from the already-published Topaz/Adobe upscaling card, but the SAME upscaling-restoration cluster — curator should pick at most one of {aiarty, topaz-adobe}. Byline-date precision (Jun 29); RedShark, a non-Penske allowed domain.

items.title: Runway Dev: one API to plug frontier image, video, audio and character models into any app
items.excerpt: Runway Dev is a new AI media platform for developers: a single API to integrate the best image, video, audio and real-time character models, giving access to Runway's frontier models (Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0, Act-Two) alongside third-party models like Seedance, GPT Image 2 and ElevenLabs, swappable by changing one line of code.
items.why: Infrastructure that reshapes how AI-film tools and studios get built: a unified, model-agnostic API means creative-tool builders and production pipelines can wire frontier generative video/audio/character models (incl. Runway's own Gen-4.5 / Aleph 2.0 / Act-Two) into bespoke filmmaking workflows and swap models trivially. A product/platform release, not org/finance news. Runway's own posted date (Jul 8). NOTE: same outlet as #runway-seed-audio — distinct capability; curator pick <=1 Runway.

items.title: Adobe Premiere adds a Generative Media Tool: type a prompt on the timeline to make video and sound effects
items.excerpt: Scott Simmons details Premiere's new (beta) Generative Media Tool, which lets editors create generative video and sound effects directly in the timeline by dragging across empty space or double-clicking to type a prompt — Adobe's continued generative-AI push inside the dominant NLE.
items.why: A generative-AI capability landing natively in the editor most of the industry already cuts in — prompt-to-clip / prompt-to-SFX inside the Premiere timeline is a real change to the day-to-day editing/finishing workflow. Distinct from the already-published Premiere Color Mode card (that was tonal/UI, this is generative). Byline-date precision (Jul 10); ProVideo Coalition, a non-Penske allowed domain.

items.title: Runway Seed Audio 1.0: up to two minutes of prompt-generated speech, sound design and music
items.excerpt: Runway's Seed Audio 1.0 generates up to 120 seconds of dynamic speech, sound design and music from simple text prompts — extending Runway's generative stack from image/video into film-relevant audio (scoring, sound design, ADR-style voice).
items.why: Generative audio is an under-covered but real film-craft lever: prompt-driven speech, sound design and temp music/score inside the same toolchain filmmakers use for AI video. A concrete capability release (changelog-dated Jun 29). WEAKER as a standalone card (thin changelog entry, no dedicated article page) and SAME outlet as #runway-dev — included as pool depth; curator should pick at most one Runway item.
